resting_heart_rate_bpm.note: Commonly used clinical resting range 60-100 bpm. In-flight resting heart rate is about the same as pre-flight (Norsk 2015; Hughson 2017); see docs/SOURCES.md

sleep_hours.note: CDC: adults need at least 7 h. ISS crews are scheduled 8.5 h but average about 6 h (Barger 2014); see docs/SOURCES.md

stress_score.note: App-defined 0-100 composite; calibrate per crew baseline

blood_pressure_systolic_mmhg.note: AHA categories: normal below 120/80, stage 2 hypertension from 140/90, crisis above 180/120. In-flight systolic pressure runs about 7-10 mmHg lower (Norsk 2015; Hughson 2017)

body_temperature_c.note: Fever threshold 38.0 C. Core temperature runs about 1 C higher after roughly 75 days on the ISS (Stahn 2017); see docs/SOURCES.md

mood_score_1_10.note: Self-reported daily mood, 1-10; low mood is an early behavioral-health signal

steps_per_day.note: In-flight exercise countermeasure target ~2.5h/day; steps are a proxy only

lab_panels.note: Reference ranges come with the OSDR data itself (ref_min/ref_max per indicator); flag low/high vs those ranges
